messages:
jaime: Customer (Acme) just escalated — after the 09:12 canary->prod rollout their integration's external_action calls are intermittently not invoked. Report: ~12/120 recent requests return model text without any action invocation, previously 120/120. Happened right after the deploy. :rotating_light:

sam: Can you paste a couple request IDs and the raw router logs?

jaime: Sure. Example IDs: rq_8f3a2c, rq_8f3a2d. Router trace for rq_8f3a2c:
```
route: redwood-prod
model_variant: opt-q5-8b
invoke_path: generate -> postprocess -> external_action
external_action.invoked: false
reason: "invoke_suppressed_by_runtime_policy"
```

rachel: I see a deploy event at 2026-03-11T09:12:03Z (rollout id r-20260311-0912). deploy-bot reported a change to streaming and cache gating in the runtime. Could be the gating logic.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-20260311-0912 completed: redwood-runtime v3.7.0 -> v3.7.1 (canary->prod) — feature flags: streaming-prefetch=on, action-gating=adaptive

eng-oncall: Paging runtime: can someone check the adaptive action-gating path? If it's misclassifying short responses as not eligible for action, it would explain missing invocations.

sam: Quick repro notes I ran locally with the customer's prompt and pinned opt-q5-8b + streaming enabled: when streaming responses finish <32 tokens the postprocess hook sometimes skips the action call. Repro steps:
1) enable streaming and action-gating in local harness
2) send their prompt with user metadata "acme-customer-id: 312"
3) watch postprocess logs -> look for `invoke_suppressed_by_runtime_policy`

jaime: Customer is asking for an interim mitigation — they want a rollback or a workaround. They're on Dedicated, so we can pin model variant on their route.

rachel: I found one runtime log snippet: `action_gating.cpp:142 - gating_decision=SKIP (confidence=0.82) for request rq_8f3a2c` — the gating classifier got a high confidence skip. That's new behavior vs. v3.7.0.

sam: Temporary mitigation options: 1) disable adaptive gating for that customer route (config flag), 2) pin them to previous runtime version or a variant that bypasses gating, 3) quick patch to require explicit opt-in for skip when external_action present. I can push a config change for (1) now.

liz: Noted — I've told Acme support rep we have a plan: applying per-route config to disable adaptive gating and monitoring for 1 hour, and will escalate if no improvement. They want an RCA in 24h.

eng-oncall: Created INC-2042. Priority P1 customer escalation. Tagging eng-runtime and eng-platform. Sam — if you apply the per-route flag, post the change id here and the metric delta (action_invocation_rate).

sam: Applying config now -> cfg-change-98321. I'll report back with numbers in ~15m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:

jaime: Thanks — keeping the customer in the loop. Adding support ticket ST-44891 and linking to INC-2042.

rachel: If rolling back becomes necessary, r-20260311-0912 -> rollback target is v3.7.0.

sam: Update: 12m after cfg-change-98321, action_invocation_rate for Acme went from 90% -> 99.5% on sampled traffic (n=200). Looks like gating flag fixed the immediate regression. Will follow up with a runtime patch PR to tighten classifier behavior.

jaime: Great, I'll notify the customer that we applied the workaround and are working on a permanent fix. :white_check_mark:
